title: Hidden-State Privacy Has an Empty Middle
abstract: arXiv:2605.24042v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Of $1{,}536$ Gaussian release covariances we tested for single-layer hidden-state privacy, zero achieve both moderate utility and moderate privacy against an adaptive retrieval attacker. We prove a complementary Fisher-ball lower bound: every full-rank Gaussian release at $O(1)$ Fisher utility admits a direction whose Mahalanobis signal grows linearly in hidden width, ruling out uniform Gaussian safety in the class and matching the empirical empty middle. The diagonal inverse-Fisher release $\Sigma^\star_{\mathrm{diag}}(\mathcal{K}) = (2\mathcal{K}/d)\,\mathrm{diag}(1/F_{ii})$ is the unique minimax-optimal diagonal mechanism at first-order KL budget $\mathcal{K}$ and the only release with worst-attacker top-1 $\le 0.001$ at every point of a 32 model-layer grid, but it sits on a privacy/utility edge rather than filling the middle. A generalized-eigen mechanism reaching $13\times$ Pareto reduction under Euclidean retrieval collap

translated_title: 隐藏状态隐私存在“空缺中段”
translated_abstract: 在我们为单层隐藏状态隐私测试的1,536个高斯发布协方差中，没有任何一个能够在面对自适应检索攻击者时同时实现中等效用与中等隐私。我们证明了一个互补的Fisher球下界：每一个在O(1) Fisher效用下的满秩高斯发布都存在某个方向，其马氏距离信号随隐藏宽度线性增长，这排除了该类机制中一致的高斯安全性，并与经验上观察到的空缺中段相吻合。对角逆Fisher发布 Σ*_diag(𝒦) = (2𝒦/d)·diag(1/F_ii) 是在一阶KL预算𝒦下唯一的极小极大最优对角机制，也是在32个模型层网格的每个点上，唯一实现最坏攻击者top-1 ≤ 0.001的发布机制，但它位于隐私/效用的边缘，而非填补中段。一种广义特征值机制在欧氏检索崩溃下达到了13倍的帕累托缩减（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过对1,536个高斯协方差的实证测试和Fisher球理论下界的证明，揭示了隐藏状态隐私发布中存在“空缺中段”现象——不存在任何能同时提供中等效用与中等隐私的高斯机制，并指出对角逆Fisher发布是唯一达到极小极大最优的机制，但只能处于隐私/效用的极端边缘。
en_tdlr: By empirically testing 1,536 Gaussian covariances and proving a complementary Fisher-ball lower bound, this paper establishes that hidden-state privacy has an "empty middle" — no Gaussian release achieves both moderate utility and moderate privacy — while showing the diagonal inverse-Fisher release is the unique minimax-optimal mechanism that sits only at the privacy/utility edge.
